title: Working Man with Tool Tray, 1947 B&W Snapshot, Vintage Portrait
description: A full-length black and white candid portrait of a man holding a metal tool carrier or tray outdoors, taken on May 30, 1947. He wears a buttoned cardigan sweater over a collared shirt and work trousers. Behind him are large leafy trees and two vintage post-WWII automobiles (including a late 1940s Chevrolet). This image offers a glimpse into post-war working-class American life on Memorial Day weekend.
